name: JK Kaseifu wa Mita Koumon
source:
"Since you failed you entrance exams you're not allowed to stay at home. You have to live on your own… got it!?"


After being sternly told this by his father, Kakeru moved out and started living alone. 

That said, his doting father rented him a high-end apartment in the city and gave him a hefty monthly allowance. 

Having grown used to having a housekeeper take care of everything, Kakeru didn't hesitate to hire one. 
But to his surprise, the housekeeper who showed up was an actual high school girl attending JK Academy. 

Her name was Mita. 
At first glance, Mita seemed blunt and no-nonsense, but she was willing to do anything if it was part of her job duties. 

Kakeru, who had always fantasized about the kind of hardcore ero-manga scenarios he could indulge in, decided to unleash all his perverted desires on Mita.

translation:
“既然你考试落榜了，就不准待在家里。你必须自己生活……明白了吗！？”

被父亲严厉地训斥后，翔搬了出去，开始独自生活。不过，溺爱他的父亲在市中心为他租了一套高级公寓，还给了他丰厚的月度零花钱。

习惯了有管家照料一切的翔毫不犹豫地雇了一个。但令他惊讶的是，来的管家竟然是一名就读于JK学院的真正女高中生。

她的名字叫美多。乍一看，美多显得直率而干练，但如果属于工作职责范围内，她愿意做任何事情。

翔一直幻想着能沉浸在那种硬核色情漫画般的场景中，于是决定将自己所有的变态欲望都发泄在美多身上。
